songs.title: 스물아홉 해를 걸어온 아이
songs.title_en: The Child Who Walked Twenty-Nine Years
songs.facet: 삶을 위에서 굽어보는 서곡 — 스물아홉 해의 아름다움과 신산함을 함께 껴안는 장엄한 경외
songs.style_prompt: Cinematic classical crossover / epic film-score overture, 76 BPM, A minor, 4/4. A prominent SOLO CELLO carries the entire piece — warm, singing arco melody in the tenor register, rich vibrato, expressive legato; the cello stays foregrounded throughout. Around it a full film-score orchestra: soft sustained strings, warm French horn swells, delicate harp arpeggios, distant piano, subtle timpani rolls building the arc. A WORDLESS CHOIR (mixed SATB 'ooh/aah' pad) floats as ethereal texture behind the cello, swelling in the chorus. Lead vocal: a tender, mature Korean male baritone, intimate yet noble, storytelling delivery. Dynamics arc from a hushed, misty solo-cello intro to a majestic, sweeping full-orchestra-and-choir climax, then settles into a warm bittersweet resolve. Reverberant concert-hall space, cinematic grandeur, majestic, warm, tender, a little bittersweet — the awe of a life reaching twenty-nine. Clean mix, wide stereo, no percussion clutter.

songs.style_prompt: Warm late-afternoon jazz-club crossover, smoky and unhurried. A SOLO CELLO leads throughout as the constant voice — rich low arco lines, sighing legato, expressive vibrato answering the vocal like a duet partner. Classical cello fused with an intimate JAZZ TRIO: mellow jazz piano with soft block chords and tasteful comping fills, brushed drums with a relaxed swung ride, warm walking upright bass. Medium-slow swing feel, laid-back behind the beat, triplet-shuffle pulse. Vocal: warm, intimate male jazz croon, close-mic, breathy and self-aware, conversational phrasing with subtle scatting between lines. Dynamics: soft verses that lean into the cello, a fuller warm chorus, a smoky mid-song cello-and-piano interlude trading phrases. Bb major with lush jazz color — 7ths, 9ths, ii-V motion. Mood: mellow mature contentment with a wistful undercurrent, an evening drink savored slowly. Analog warmth, vinyl-soft room, brushed intimacy, tape saturation. Instrumental=OFF.

songs.style_prompt: Nuevo tango crossover in the spirit of Piazzolla, A minor, 112 BPM, 4/4. SOLO CELLO is the star and carries the bandoneon's melancholic lead line — deep, singing, rubato phrasing that swells and bites. Argentine tango bandoneon breathing underneath, sharp staccato tango violin, marcato grand piano stabs on the beat, plucked upright bass walking the tango rhythm. Dramatic dynamics: hushed sultry verses erupting into fiery, sweeping choruses. Passionate male vocal, warm baritone with theatrical intensity and controlled ache, intimate then soaring. Bittersweet, fiery, defiant elegance — the feeling of dancing through hardship with your chin up. Rubato accelerandos, dramatic pauses, chromatic tango color, minor-key tension resolving into proud release. Rich cinematic reverb, close-mic cello resonance. Live concert-hall energy, tight ensemble breathing together. Instrumental=OFF.

songs.style_prompt: Warm, homemade birthday folk with a classical crossover heart. A solo cello sings the through-line — expressive, singing arco melody with tender vibrato, low sustained warmth under the verses and a soaring countermelody in the chorus. Intimate fingerpicked steel-string acoustic guitar carries the rhythm, gentle rolling patterns. Light hand percussion: soft shaker, brushed cajon, a knee-tap pulse. A glimmering glockenspiel adds sparkle on the hook. Warm, close-mic'd male lead vocal, unpolished and heartfelt, joined by a small group of friends singing along in loose harmony on the choruses — living-room warmth, a few smiles you can hear. Gentle dynamics, breathing between phrases, a soft build into each chorus then settling back. G major, around 92 BPM, 4/4. Mood: tender, grateful, quietly joyful — the simple wonder of being alive and loved. Analog, cozy, candlelit, present. Instrumental=OFF.

songs.style_prompt: Classical-gospel crossover, warm and redemptive. A single expressive SOLO CELLO is the through-line—rich vibrato, singing legato, weaving countermelodies like a second voice. Powerful, soulful LEAD MALE VOCAL, tender then soaring with grit and gospel runs. Full SATB GOSPEL CHOIR (soprano/alto/tenor/bass), lush CALL-AND-RESPONSE, big communal harmonies and shouts of joy. Gentle gospel grand PIANO with bluesy fills, HAMMOND ORGAN swells and B3 leslie shimmer, warm upright bass. HAND-CLAPS on 2 and 4, tambourine, brushed then driving drums. Build from intimate to triumphant: hushed verse, lifting pre-chorus, huge cathartic chorus. One section is A CAPPELLA—choir and cello ONLY, no drums, pure vocal harmony and cello, tears-of-joy dynamics. Ritardando swells, key-lift final chorus. Ab major, ~74 BPM, 4/4. Sacred yet celebratory, uplifting, cinematic warmth, live-room reverb, wide dynamics. Korean lyrics, crystal-clear diction. Instrumental=OFF.

songs.style_prompt: Classical-Celtic crossover, rolling 6/8 lilt at ~104 BPM in E minor with modal color. A warm SOLO CELLO leads as the emotional through-line: rich low-register bowing, singing legato lines, occasional pizzicato steps like footfalls on a road. Around the cello weave a Celtic fiddle (double-stops, ornaments, lonesome high sustains), a tin whistle and low whistle trading airy folk melodies, a bright plucked Celtic harp arpeggiating underneath, bodhran frame drum giving a soft rolling heartbeat pulse, subtle uilleann-pipe drone color on the swells. Emotive tenor male vocal, weathered and warm, storyteller phrasing, close and intimate in verses. Build from a lone cello-and-whistle opening to full windswept ensemble in choruses, then breathe back down. Nostalgic, hopeful, homecoming warmth, wide open-air atmosphere with gentle reverb. Dynamic swells, ritardando at the close. Acoustic, organic, cinematic folk. Instrumental=OFF, vocals present throughout.

songs.style_prompt: Passionate Classical-Flamenco crossover, dramatic duende. SOLO CELLO front and center (Jio's cello), fiery bowed lines and rapid spiccato that trade blazing phrases with a flamenco nylon guitar (rasgueado strums, picado runs, golpe taps). E Phrygian, ~132 BPM, 12-count compás flavor over 4/4. Palmas hand-claps (sordas and claras), cajón driving the pulse, thunderous zapateado foot-stomps, sharp jaleo shouts ("olé!", "vamos!"). Impassioned male vocal, raspy chest voice with long flamenco melisma and quarter-tone bends, cante jondo grief-and-joy. Cello answers the voice like a second singer, then erupts in a virtuosic fiery cadenza against furious rasgueado. Dynamic build from smoldering rubato intro to full-fire climax, hand-clap breakdown, dead-stop remate ending. Warm nylon strings, resonant low cello, intimate stomping room ambience, sweat and fire. Beauty and pain fused, life lived fully. Instrumental=OFF.

songs.style_prompt: Epic classical-rock ballad crossover, cathartic and anthemic. SOLO CELLO is the constant emotional lead throughout — warm, singing, soaring; it opens alone and owns the outro with a huge climbing melody. Begins quiet and intimate: lone cello, soft grand piano, a single male lead voice, tender and worn but hopeful. Slow build. Clean electric guitar enters shimmering, then bass and restrained drums. Chorus lifts: distorted electric guitars, powerful full drum kit, swelling string orchestra behind the solo cello. Powerful, emotional male lead vocal, rock-ballad phrasing, chest voice climbing to a belting top. Key rises from A minor into a triumphant C major lift. FINAL CHORUS explodes into a massive GANG VOCAL CHOIR — layered communal unison and harmonies, tear-in-the-eye singalong energy. Outro: solo cello soars over sustained orchestral swell and choir 'oohs', ringing guitars, then resolves warm and tender. Live, organic, cinematic, celebratory. Instrumental=OFF.
